executive_summary: 2026-08-11 正式 RadarReportV2 已完成並通過 report quality gate：status=partial、ingestion_mode=live_multi，共 225 件事件（133 Major／92 Potential），其中 95 件含台灣直接證據；量體已超過 review threshold，因此今天更重要的是去除噪音，而不是繼續堆新聞數。
今日最值得追的國際動作是 AI 基礎建設融資結構開始改變：正式雷達已抓到 Nvidia 與大型金融機構籌組逾 5,000 億美元 AI 融資平台；Reuters 補搜確認六家資產管理／金融機構參與，Nvidia 可選擇 backstop 最多 1,250 億美元。AI 競賽正在從『誰買最多 GPU』延伸到『誰能組織資本、信用與實體電力』。
台灣 AI 供應鏈的正式事件仍有實際營收與先進製造需求穿透，因此不能只用泡沫敘事解讀；但 IEA 補搜顯示資料中心已成為電力需求的結構性驅動，意味下一個瓶頸會更靠近電力、環評、融資條件與利用率，而非單純晶片供給。

Retail 正式 lane 今天只有 4 件，membership_crm_loyalty_retail_media 仍是唯一 matrix gap。Ulta 官方補搜顯示 Ulta Beauty at Target 將於 8/15 後結束，跨 Ulta Rewards／Target Circle 的聯動權益也終止，但既有 Ulta 點數仍保留。這個小眾案例的價值在於：跨平台會員能力不只要設計整合，也要設計拆分、點數歸屬與資料退出。
Crypto 正式矩陣唯一缺口是 perp_dex_volume_oi_funding。DefiLlama 可補到當前 volume/OI，Hyperliquid 官方文件也有 funding/OI 相關協議與 API 路徑，但本輪沒有取得可驗證的官方即時 funding snapshot，因此只能標為部分補齊，不能改寫正式 matrix。
三個 structural 與六個 linked indicators 一律保留 deterministic baseline，不由 ChatGPT 改分。但今天 structural evidence mapping 出現明顯語義污染，三個指標同時飽和到 support=100、counter=100、confidence=0；這應視為 evaluator 品質警報，而不是市場真的完全五五波。

counterevidence: 台灣先進製造與封測營收仍有實際增長，顯示需求並非純金融敘事。
若大型 AI 客戶現金流與利用率持續高企，第三方融資可能主要是資本效率工具，而非需求不足的掩飾。

future_trends.summary: 3 個月內，預期會有更多 compute / data-center financing、供應商 backstop、專案融資或長約結構被公開；6 個月內，市場焦點會從『花多少 Capex』轉向『誰承擔信用風險、利用率多少、電力能否落地、資產殘值如何』。若融資條件保持寬鬆且 utilization / revenue / cash flow 同步上升，則過度投資風險下降；若 backstop 動用、信用利差、取消案或電力阻塞增加，則風險上升。
future_trends.title: AI 基礎建設進入『資本結構 + 實體約束』競賽
uncertainties: Nvidia 融資平台目前尚未披露個別機構承諾額、最終條款與部署時間表。
各地電力與環評約束差異很大，不能用單一資料中心案例外推全球。

counterevidence: YOOBIC 的 3.2% uplift 是廠商自述案例，尚非獨立審計的產業平均。
WACA 公開能力以分析與建議為主，尚不足以證明已具完整自治型門市 decision loop。

future_trends.summary: 3 個月內，更多零售 SaaS 會把 AI 建議、會員分群、庫存與任務路由包在同一工作流；6 個月內，差異化將逐漸落在建議能否綁定角色權限、門市情境、回測與可量化 ROI。Ulta/Target 的會員合作退場同時提醒，跨平台能力不能只設計『怎麼串』，還要設計『怎麼拆、資料與權益怎麼歸還』。
future_trends.title: 零售 AI 從分析儀表板往可執行 action layer 下沉
uncertainties: Retail 正式 lane 今日只有 4 件，外部補搜仍不足以代表整體全球零售 SaaS 採用速度。
retail media 的同日量化成效仍缺。

counterevidence: 當前 DefiLlama snapshot 顯示 OI 高度集中於少數協議，市場深度仍非均質。
本次沒有官方即時 funding snapshot，無法確認槓桿成本是否同步健康。

future_trends.summary: 3 個月內，perp DEX 的比較將更常從單一 volume 轉向 OI、funding、fees/revenue、liquidation 與 concentration；6 個月內，如果 Hyperliquid 等協議的資料 API、第三方儀表板與監管市場資料可以互相校驗，perps 才會從高交易量產品進一步變成可被機構風控與資產配置使用的市場基礎設施。若 OI 高度集中且 funding/流動性快速惡化，則這條趨勢會被風險事件反向驗證。
future_trends.title: Perp DEX 競爭將更依賴可驗證的 OI、funding、fees 與風險資料
uncertainties: 第三方 dashboard 為 specialist evidence，不等同交易所或鏈上原始快照。
不同協議 volume normalization 與 wash-trading 過濾方法可能不同。

key_findings.label: verified_fact
key_findings.summary: 正式雷達已抓到 Nvidia 與大型金融機構籌組逾 5,000 億美元 AI 融資平台；Reuters supplemental evidence 進一步確認 Apollo、BlackRock、Blackstone、Brookfield、Goldman Sachs、KKR 參與，Nvidia 可選擇 backstop 最多 1,250 億美元，但個別承諾、條款與部署時程仍未披露。
key_findings.title: Nvidia 把 AI 基建競爭推進到大型資本組織與信用結構

key_findings.label: ai_inference
key_findings.summary: 當 AI 基建從 hyperscaler 自有資產負債表延伸到第三方 compute financing，而私募信貸違約又在正式宏觀事件中升溫，下一層風險不只在估值，而會移到租約、專案融資、backstop、信用利差與資產殘值。這不是已發生的危機，而是 3–6 個月需要建立 adapter 的監測面。
key_findings.title: AI 過度投資的下一個驗證點可能轉向信用與融資條件

key_findings.label: verified_fact
key_findings.summary: 正式事件同時出現 Nvidia 投資能源基礎設施、Google 印度資料中心遭遇環境阻力與海上資料中心等替代架構。IEA supplemental evidence 又把 data-centre expansion 列為 2026–2027 電力需求的結構性驅動，顯示 AI 基建瓶頸正在從算力本身外溢到電力、土地、環評與冷卻。
key_findings.title: AI 的稀缺資源開始從 GPU 外溢到電力、土地與環評

key_findings.label: verified_fact
key_findings.summary: 正式事件顯示 TSMC 7 月營收大幅成長並創高、日月光 7 月營收首破 700 億元，同時台積電與 Sony 影像感測合作持續擴大先進製造應用。這些是實際出貨與營收訊號，意味 AI/高效能運算投資即使存在融資風險，也不能直接等同需求虛化。
key_findings.title: 台灣 AI 供應鏈仍有實際營收穿透，不宜只用泡沫敘事解讀

key_findings.label: uncertainty
key_findings.summary: 正式 structural indicators 的 missing_data 雖為空，但 K 型經濟、AI 過度投資、品牌兩極化全部同時飽和到 support=100、counter=100、confidence=0。底層可看到 FIFA、刺青求職、學術論文、Bitcoin premium 等不相干事件被關鍵字吸入組件。這是 evaluator 品質問題，不應被解讀成『市場真的完全五五波』。
key_findings.title: 三個結構指標今天失去方向性，主因是 deterministic semantic mapping 污染

key_findings.label: verified_fact
key_findings.summary: Ulta 官方 FAQ 顯示 Ulta Beauty at Target 於 8 月 15 日後終止，linked Ulta Beauty Rewards / Target Circle 的相關利益亦終止，但已累積的 Ulta 點數留在 Ulta 帳戶。這補上正式 Retail membership gap 的一部分，也顯示跨品牌會員合作必須把帳號連結、點數歸屬、退場與資料邊界設計成一等公民。
key_findings.title: 跨品牌 loyalty federation 的退場案例正在提供新的營運設計訊號

key_findings.label: ai_inference
key_findings.summary: YOOBIC 官方案例把 Store Manager Copilot 定位為把門市資料轉成每日優先行動，並宣稱 HUGO BOSS 有 3.2% incremental revenue 與每店每週 2.4 個可辨識機會；WACA 公開方案則已把 OMO、會員、庫存、AI 數據中心與營運建議包在同一產品。這兩條線都指向相同方向：只做分析看板的差異化會縮小，真正的競爭點是建議能否正確路由到人、權限與流程。
key_findings.title: 零售 AI 競爭正在從看板移到『資料轉任務』的 action layer

key_findings.label: verified_fact
key_findings.summary: DefiLlama 當前 perps dashboard 提供市場與協議層的 24 小時成交量及 OI，Hyperliquid 官方文件亦存在 funding/OI 的協議與 API 路徑。由於本次外部搜尋未取得可驗證的官方即時 funding snapshot，因此只能把 matrix gap 從『完全缺資料』降為『部分補齊』，不能偽裝成正式 observed。
key_findings.title: Perp DEX 缺口已補到 volume / OI，但 funding 仍未正式閉合

limitations: Formal RadarReportV2 is valid for 2026-08-11 but status=partial, ingestion_mode=live_multi. Coverage gaps remain: FreshRSS credentials unavailable and one fixed competitor check (WACA) failed. External discovery plus web/API/social adapters are not wired into the formal RSS composition.

The baseline auto AIAnalysisV1 did not pass the production AI gate because it fell back to deterministic mode with provider/model absent and fallback_used=true. The daily workflow therefore deployed report-only output; this chat-assisted import is an interpretation-layer repair tied to the same report/run/hash, not a replacement facts pipeline.

Retail matrix gap membership_crm_loyalty_retail_media is only partially supplemented. Ulta/Target provides strong official loyalty/account evidence, but same-day retail-media measurement, incrementality and Taiwan AI-referral conversion data remain missing.

Crypto matrix gap perp_dex_volume_oi_funding is only partially supplemented. DefiLlama provides specialist volume/OI measurements and Hyperliquid provides first-party protocol/API documentation, but no verified official live funding-rate snapshot was captured in this run.

All three structural indicators report formal missing_data=[], but their immutable deterministic evidence mapping is semantically polluted and saturated at support=100/counter=100/confidence=0. Examples include unrelated FIFA/job/tattoo, academic-model and crypto-premium items. These baseline arrays are preserved unchanged as required; their directional scores should be quarantined from decisions until a domain/entity/semantic-entailment gate is added.

The run produced 225 items and 133 Major items, above review thresholds 180 and 90. High volume likely magnifies keyword-driven false positives; unrelated or weakly related items are visible in Retail/Crypto and structural-component mappings. More events today does not equal better signal.

Public-source gap search disposition: Anthropic official newsroom surfaced no same-day verifiable item; IMF official news had no same-day update beyond the July WEO background; TWSE announcement search did not surface a same-day material item; MOL official pages showed no same-day relevant release; Legislative Yuan and FSC supplied the July virtual-asset law trail; Executive Yuan and MOEA supplied current background policy/statistics; laws.moj.gov.tw did not surface a fresher indexed item than the FSC primary law page.

CBC explicitly schedules its next reserve-money release for 2026-08-11 16:20 Taiwan time, after this morning run; BLS schedules July CPI/Real Earnings for 2026-08-12 08:30 ET. Future releases were not guessed or backfilled.

Commercial Times direct search was blocked by robots.txt; CryptoCity search surfaced only older results rather than a same-day verifiable gap filler. FreshRSS collection cannot be externally reconstructed because the formal credentials/inbox are unavailable.

Supplemental evidence remains separately typed and must not be treated as native RadarReportV2 events. Any unsupported external-only finding uses source_event_ids=[] and is traceable through supplemental_evidence.

supplemental_evidence.summary: Reuters confirms Nvidia partnered with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR on compute-financing platforms targeting more than $500B of third-party AI infrastructure capital; Nvidia has an option to backstop up to $125B, while detailed commitments, terms and deployment timing were not disclosed.
supplemental_evidence.title: Nvidia partners with Wall Street giants to raise $500 billion for AI buildout

supplemental_evidence.summary: Ulta states Ulta Beauty at Target ends after Aug 15, 2026. Linked Ulta Beauty Rewards and Target Circle benefits cease after that date, while previously earned Ulta points remain in the Ulta account. This partially fills the membership/loyalty gap but does not supply retail-media performance measurement.
supplemental_evidence.title: Ulta Beauty Rewards FAQ: Ulta Beauty at Target ends after August 15, 2026

supplemental_evidence.summary: The fetched DefiLlama perps page shows sector 24h perp volume and open interest plus protocol-level volume/OI, including Hyperliquid. It is useful as a specialist measurement cross-check, but it does not close the funding-rate portion of the formal matrix gap.
supplemental_evidence.title: DefiLlama Perp DEX dashboard current snapshot

supplemental_evidence.summary: Hyperliquid official documentation exposes perpetual-market primitives for open-interest caps and funding multipliers/interest rates and points to official info-endpoint queries. The radar should add a first-party API adapter instead of relying only on media/keyword evidence for the perp matrix.
supplemental_evidence.title: Hyperliquid official HIP-3 perpetual DEX documentation

supplemental_evidence.summary: WACA's live official pricing page exposes OMO POS, membership tiers/points, multi-store inventory, cross-store pickup, customer statistics and AI Data Center tiers. Public search can access WACA pages, so today's HTTP 405 is best treated as an adapter/path behavior failure rather than proof that the official source is unavailable.
supplemental_evidence.title: WACA OMO POS plans include membership, inventory and AI Data Center

supplemental_evidence.summary: YOOBIC says Store Manager Copilot routes store data into daily actions and reports a 3.2% incremental revenue uplift at HUGO BOSS with 2.4 identifiable opportunities per store per week. This is vendor-reported evidence, not independent audit, but it materially supports the competitor shift toward an action layer.
supplemental_evidence.title: YOOBIC: AI in retail, store data to action

supplemental_evidence.summary: IEA forecasts global electricity demand growth of 3.6% in 2026 and 3.8% in 2027 and identifies expanding data-centre capacity as a structural demand driver; US electricity demand is forecast to rise close to 2% in 2026 led partly by data centres. This supports the AI power-bottleneck interpretation without converting it into RadarReportV2 evidence.
supplemental_evidence.title: IEA Electricity Mid-Year Update 2026

supplemental_evidence.summary: BLS schedules July 2026 CPI and Real Earnings for Aug 12 at 08:30 ET. At the time of this Aug 11 Taiwan run, those data do not yet exist, so the radar must not infer or backfill July CPI values.
supplemental_evidence.title: BLS 2026 release calendar: July CPI scheduled for August 12

supplemental_evidence.summary: FSC's official law system records the Virtual Asset Service Act as promulgated on Jul 22, 2026, defines virtual-asset service categories and requires providers to obtain permissions by business type. Some provisions were not yet effective at publication.
supplemental_evidence.title: Taiwan Virtual Asset Service Act

supplemental_evidence.summary: MOEA reports June 2026 Taiwan retail sales of NT$421.3B, up 8.0% year over year; e-commerce/postal retail rose 7.3% and department stores 8.9%. This supplies direct Taiwan retail context but is background, not a same-day event.
supplemental_evidence.title: MOEA June 2026 wholesale, retail and food-service sales

supplemental_evidence.summary: The Executive Yuan says the service-sector AI upgrade program targets retail, food service, logistics and franchises with smart analytics, logistics management, inventory management and customer-service applications. This is direct Taiwan policy evidence for the data-to-action retail direction.
supplemental_evidence.title: Executive Yuan: Service-sector AI upgrade program

supplemental_evidence.summary: CBC's June reserve-money release states the next release is scheduled for Aug 11 at 16:20 Taiwan time, later than this morning's radar run. The missing same-day CBC update is therefore a timing issue, not a number to estimate.
supplemental_evidence.title: CBC June reserve money release and next release timing
